pages.text: Restraints share one usage: hold the item and $(thing)right-click the target$() to put it on; use again on an equipped target to take it off. Equipped targets gain the corresponding restrained state with various limitations~
$(item)Handcuffs$() — while cuffed, the target cannot use items. There are also $(item)Handcuff Ring$() and $(item)Handcuff Chain$() accessories for extra fun.
$(item)Shackles$() — greatly slows the target's movement. Trying to run? Not a chance~
$(item)Binding Rope$() — ties the target up tight, unable to move a muscle. «So this is what you're into?»
